Questions

What wages does WageGrid publish?

WageGrid republishes BLS OEWS May 2025 estimates for 25 occupations in Austin, Chicago, and Seattle. Example published annual medians for Software Developers: Austin $134,120, Chicago $134,380, Seattle $167,280.

Does WageGrid invent missing wages?

No. Every dollar amount is an official OEWS estimate. BLS suppressions stay blank. Cite BLS OEWS when quoting a figure.

Is this legal or career advice?

These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice. Cite BLS OEWS when quoting a wage.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
